spans.text: Then why did you do this?

units.rawText: To break the curse, of course!
units.displayText: To break the curse, of course!

spans.text: To break the curse, of course!

units.rawText: That mean old witch said that my curse would only be broken when I heard the best song and saw the best dance at a grand banquet.
units.displayText: That mean old witch said that my curse would only be broken when I heard the best song and saw the best dance at a grand banquet.

spans.text: That mean old witch said that my curse would only be broken when I heard the best song and saw the best dance at a grand banquet.

units.rawText: So I thought of getting pretty girls to sing and dance for me! And I decorated the castle ahead of time so I could host a banquet more easily, but now you've ruined everything!

units.rawText: Saying so, Li'l Kuro produces a hand mirror from her pocket.
units.displayText: Saying so, Li'l Kuro produces a hand mirror from her pocket.

spans.text: Saying so, Li'l Kuro produces a hand mirror from her pocket.

units.rawText: Here. At first, I was looking for this pretty lady.
units.displayText: Here. At first, I was looking for this pretty lady.

spans.text: Here. At first, I was looking for this pretty lady.

units.rawText: But I couldn't find her even after overflying Pyrewood so many times. The weather was getting so cold that even I couldn't stand it, so I decided to go look myself.
units.displayText: But I couldn't find her even after overflying Pyrewood so many times. The weather was getting so cold that even I couldn't stand it, so I decided to go look myself.

spans.text: But I couldn't find her even after overflying Pyrewood so many times. The weather was getting so cold that even I couldn't stand it, so I decided to go look myself.

units.rawText: Is that... Big Sis?
units.displayText: Is that... Big Sis?

spans.text: Is that... Big Sis?

units.rawText: The person reflected in Li'l Kuro's mirror is Princess Nanaka, performing a lively song and dance number.
units.displayText: The person reflected in Li'l Kuro's mirror is Princess Nanaka, performing a lively song and dance number.

spans.text: The person reflected in Li'l Kuro's mirror is Princess Nanaka, performing a lively song and dance number.

units.rawText: Huh? She's your big sister? Then how come I didn't see her even after passing by so many times?
units.displayText: Huh? She's your big sister? Then how come I didn't see her even after passing by so many times?

spans.text: Huh? She's your big sister? Then how come I didn't see her even after passing by so many times?

units.rawText: She fell asleep long ago in order to make a prophecy against the evil dragon.
units.displayText: She fell asleep long ago in order to make a prophecy against the evil dragon.

spans.text: She fell asleep long ago in order to make a prophecy against the evil dragon.

units.rawText: What... But how could this be!?
units.displayText: What... But how could this be!?

spans.text: What... But how could this be!?

units.rawText: (Sob) Nanaka, my only consolation (sniffle) how could you fall asleep like that!
units.displayText: (Sob) Nanaka, my only consolation (sniffle) how could you fall asleep like that!

spans.text: (Sob) Nanaka, my only consolation (sniffle) how could you fall asleep like that!

units.rawText: I'll find some way to awaken you...
units.displayText: I'll find some way to awaken you...

spans.text: I'll find some way to awaken you...

units.rawText: With your dragon claws?
units.displayText: With your dragon claws?

spans.text: With your dragon claws?

units.rawText: Heck no. My claws are too big, they'd hurt her.
units.displayText: Heck no. My claws are too big, they'd hurt her.

spans.text: Heck no. My claws are too big, they'd hurt her.

units.rawText: ...Oh yeah, then what about my curse!?
units.displayText: ...Oh yeah, then what about my curse!?

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: Chelsea scratches her head and then reflexively looks at me.
units.displayText: Chelsea scratches her head and then reflexively looks at me.

spans.text: Chelsea scratches her head and then reflexively looks at me.

units.rawText: Professor, you know how to make shill armies. Surely you know how to solve the problem of the evil dragon, right?
units.displayText: Professor, you know how to make shill armies. Surely you know how to solve the problem of the evil dragon, right?

spans.text: Professor, you know how to make shill armies. Surely you know how to solve the problem of the evil dragon, right?

units.rawText: You know, I would LOVE to know myself, but it's not as though Angela handed me a walkthrough when she shoved me in here.
units.displayText: You know, I would LOVE to know myself, but it's not as though Angela handed me a walkthrough when she shoved me in here.

spans.text: You know, I would LOVE to know myself, but it's not as though Angela handed me a walkthrough when she shoved me in here.

units.rawText: Still, as I look at Chelsea's expectant eyes, I have no choice to swallow that wisecrack and make a decision.
units.displayText: Still, as I look at Chelsea's expectant eyes, I have no choice to swallow that wisecrack and make a decision.

spans.text: Still, as I look at Chelsea's expectant eyes, I have no choice to swallow that wisecrack and make a decision.
